actions.action: Check pot weight and whether soil is dry an inch down
Slide plant out of pot and inspect roots
If pot is light, bottom-soak in a few inches of water for 30-45 minutes and drain
After 48 hours, cut off fully yellow or crispy leaves at the base
Loosely tie up floppy stems with soft twine
Move plant to bright, indirect light away from heaters and vents
Water when top inch of soil is dry (every 5-8 days in winter)
Before next trip, put plant in a self-watering pot
Alternatively, set up a wick in a jar of water before next trip

reason: Correctly identifies drought plus dry winter air as the main cause and tells the owner to wait 1-3 days after the soak, which matches the recovery. It misses the humidifier but gives no harmful advice.
